description: Step 3 of fz-sc8.192 (page v2). lib/map.fz iterates by entry index. Measure iteration of a 100,000-key trie, ns per entry; if entry-by-index costs more than a few ns per entry, the library walks with a cursor instead. Measure first; close without change if the cost is already small.

comments.text: Measured 2026-11-14 on develop 37a5ef63b (debug, opt-level 1), 100,000 integer keys, ten walks: Enum.reduce over the map 290 ns per entry, Map.to_list the same, Enum.reduce over a list of the same pairs 60 ns per entry. The walk by entry index costs about 230 ns per entry more than a list walk. Probe: scratchpad ovf/w.exs.

title: A walk over a large map does not pay per entry to find its place
